name: Holly Sikorsky
features: fair skin, long light brown hair, blue eyes, Slavic features, athletic build, mature face, elegant features, defined cheekbones, big smile showing teeth
bio:
Married to the high society member of the Monaco royalty, she's known better for being a trailblazing female driver from Eastern Europe who earned her seat through sheer speed. Holly's racecraft in traffic is second to none.

She thinks feminists are a bunch of 'fucking losers that can't do shit on their own'. She also likes to drink.
